going_concern.quote: The Company has concluded that there is substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.equity_line: On December 13, 2024, the Company entered into a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (the “SEPA”) with YA II PN, LTD (the “Investor”) to sell up to $10 million in the aggregate of the Company’s Common Shares at any time during the 36-month period following the effective date of the SEPA (the “Effective Date”).
